items.title: Sleep timer
items.text: The moon button in the player: 15 to 90 minutes or the episode’s end. The film then pauses, your place kept, and the screen goes dark.

items.title: Steadier on a busy TV
items.text: When the TV runs short of memory, subtitles, previews and pictures now make do instead of closing the app.

items.title: Seek previews
items.text: A stream that drops while its previews are being made no longer closes the app.
